brief:
THESIS STATUS: WEAKENED
ADJUSTED CONFIDENCE: 45%

OVERNIGHT SUMMARY: Asian/European markets sold off hard (-2% to -3%) but US futures are bucking the trend with strong gains (+1-2%). VIX spiked to 25+ but is already cooling off, suggesting initial fear is being bought. The divergence between global weakness and US strength creates conflicting signals.

KEY DEVELOPMENTS:
• Global risk-off with Asia down 2-3% and Europe mostly red
• US futures strongly positive despite global weakness - classic decoupling
• VIX spike to 25.88 but already declining (-3.97% from overnight highs)
• Put wall intact at 640, call wall at 655 - key technical levels holding
• Negative GEX environment persists, supporting volatility

TRADE RECOMMENDATION STATUS: HOLD WITH TIGHT MANAGEMENT
TRADE NOTES: The bear put spread is still viable but needs active management. SPY trading at 666+ creates headwinds. If SPY breaks above 670 convincingly, consider taking 30-40% loss. The 640 put wall provides downside support for our short strike.

DAY AHEAD RISKS:
• US strength could continue, negating global weakness narrative
• Short covering rally possible given negative sentiment
• Options expiration dynamics with 6 DTE could accelerate moves

DAY AHEAD OPPORTUNITIES:
• Fade the gap if US opens too strong (670+ area)
• Global weakness could eventually catch up to US markets
• Negative GEX supports larger moves in either direction - volatility play intact
